title: DealsFlow: An Evidence-Gated Agentic Harness for Venture Capital Deal Triage
title_zh: DealsFlow：用于风险投资交易初筛的证据门控智能体框架

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) can read unstructured startup pitch decks, but letting them emit investment scores directly invites score inflation from promotional language, run-to-run variance, and rationales that are hard to audit. We describe DealsFlow, a human-in-the-loop agentic harness deployed at a UK early-stage fund, built on one design rule: the LLM reads the deck, cites evidence and rates each category, and code combines the ratings, caps them and only ever lowers them. Three mechanisms implement the rule: (i) a stage-aware corroboration ceiling that caps factual-category scores at 78, 70 or 60 out of 100 (early-stage, unknown-stage, growth-stage) unless a claim is matched to an external source; (ii) an asymmetric sceptic agent that may lower but never raise a category score; and (iii) a declared-dependency pre-fetch pattern in which every data source is retrieved and given a numbered index before a single generation pass, with the source list and the scores before and after each guardrail stored for audit. We evaluate the harness on a portfolio of N = 243 N=243 SEIS/EIS investments with recorded outcomes. Outcomes in such data are censored by time: none of the 73 investments made in the last two years has been written off, so entry year alone separates write-offs with an AUC of 0.72. We therefore evaluate on the 142 investments at least three years old, where entry year showed no clear discrimination (AUC 0.45) and a cross-validated logistic regression on intake fields reaches an AUC of 0.64. Because corroboration is exactly the signal that hindsight can contaminate (successful companies leave more public evidence), we make leakage the centre of the evaluation. Our retrieval is not restricted to the decision date, so we treat leakage as a risk to be measured rather than one we have removed: we run a leakage audit that reports corroboration rates by outcome class and compares against a corroboration-only baseline, and we list the leakage channels we do not control. On these mature investments, the full pipeline’s composite score has a Spearman correlation of ρ = 0.45 \rho=0.45 (95% CI [0.32, 0.57]) with the total-value multiple and an AUC of 0.71 [0.62, 0.79] for identifying write-offs, against ρ = 0.38 \rho=0.38 and AUC 0.68 for an unconstrained LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）能够阅读非结构化的初创公司路演材料，但如果让它们直接输出投资评分，就会因为宣传性语言、逐次运行间的波动以及难以审计的理由而导致评分虚高。 我们介绍 DealsFlow，一个部署在英国某早期投资基金的人机协同智能体框架，它建立在一项设计规则之上：由 LLM 阅读路演材料、引用证据并对每个类别打分，而由代码来组合这些评分、设置上限，并且只会调低而不会调高评分。 三个机制实现了这一规则：（i）分阶段校证上限，在未将论断匹配到外部来源时，将事实类别的分数上限设为 100 分中的 78、70 或 60（分别对应早期阶段、阶段不明和成长阶段）；（ii）非对称怀疑者智能体，它只能调低而绝不能调高类别分数；（iii）声明依赖预取模式，即在任何生成过程开始之前，先检索所有数据源并为其分配编号索引，同时保存来源清单以及每道护栏前后的分数以供审计。 我们在一个包含 N = 243 笔有 recorded 结果记录的 SEIS/EIS 投资组合上评估该框架。 此类数据中的结果受到时间删失的影响：最近两年内投资的 73 笔均未被核销，因此仅凭入场年份就能以 0.72 的 AUC 区分出核销项目。 因此，我们在至少成立三年的 142 笔投资上进行评估，其中入场年份未显示出明显区分能力（AUC 0.45），而基于录入字段的交叉验证逻辑回归达到 0.64 的 AUC。 由于校证恰恰是事后认知最容易污染的信号（成功的公司会留下更多公开证据），我们将数据泄漏作为评估的核心。 我们的检索并未限定在决策日期之前，因此我们把数据泄漏视为一种需要度量的风险，而非已被消除的风险：我们运行了一项泄漏审计，按结果类别报告校证率，并与仅使用校证的基线进行比较，同时列出了我们无法控制的泄漏渠道。 在这些成熟投资上，完整流程的综合评分与总价值倍数的 Spearman 相关系数为 ρ = 0.45（95% CI [0.32, 0.57]），识别核销项目的 AUC 为 0.71 [0.62, 0.79]，而无约束的 LLM 对应指标为 ρ = 0.38 和 AUC 0.68。

paragraphs.en: UK early-stage funds investing under the Seed Enterprise Investment Scheme (SEIS) and Enterprise Investment Scheme (EIS) ( HM Revenue & Customs, 2026 ) receive far more unsolicited applications than analysts can read closely. Top-of-funnel triage (reading the deck, checking the company register, searching for the founders, competitors and market) is repetitive and time-consuming, and it is where the founder’s own optimistic framing has the most influence.
paragraphs.zh: 在种子企业投资计划（SEIS）和企业投资计划（EIS）框架下进行投资的英国早期基金（HM Revenue & Customs, 2026）收到的主动投递申请远超分析师能够细致阅读的数量。 漏斗顶部的初筛（阅读商业计划书、查询公司登记信息、搜索创始人、竞争对手和市场信息）重复且耗时，而这正是创始人自身乐观表述影响最大的环节。

paragraphs.en: LLMs are an obvious fit for reading decks ( Naveed et al., 2025 ) , but three of their known behaviours make them a poor fit for producing the final score unchecked. They tend to agree with the framing they are given ( Sharma et al., 2024 ; Perez et al., 2023 ; Ben Natan and Tsur, 2026 ) ; their outputs vary across runs even under nominally deterministic settings ( Atıl et al., 2025 ; He and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) ; and their stated rationales need not reflect what drove the output ( Turpin et al., 2023 ) . In a firm that must be able to explain later why a deal was progressed or rejected, a single opaque LLM score is hard to defend ( Rudin, 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: LLM 显然适合阅读融资路演材料（Naveed et al., 2025），但其三种已知行为使其不适合在无人核查的情况下直接产出最终评分。 它们倾向于附和所给定的表述框架（Sharma et al., 2024；Perez et al., 2023；Ben Natan and Tsur, 2026）；即使在名义上确定性的设置下，其输出在不同运行之间也会变化（Atıl et al., 2025；He and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025）；而且它们陈述的理由未必反映真正驱动输出的因素（Turpin et al., 2023）。 在一家必须能够在事后解释为何推进或否决某笔交易的公司中，单一的、不透明的 LLM 评分是难以自圆其说的（Rudin, 2019）。

paragraphs.en: DealsFlow is a decision-support harness built around one rule: the LLM reads and rates; code combines, caps and only ever lowers the ratings . It never makes an investment decision; approvals are held for explicit human sign-off. This paper describes the harness and, more importantly, asks whether its scores carry information about real outcomes once the obvious ways an evaluation of this kind can fool itself are accounted for.
paragraphs.zh: DealsFlow 是一个围绕一条规则构建的决策支持框架：由大语言模型进行阅读和评分，由代码进行汇总、设上限，并且只会下调评分。 它从不做出投资决策；批准事项始终保留给明确的人工签署确认。 本文描述了这个框架，更重要的是，在排除了此类评估可能自欺的种种明显方式之后，探讨其评分是否携带关于真实结果的信息。

paragraphs.en: The most important of these is look-ahead bias. Our main guardrail rewards claims that can be corroborated externally. Companies that later succeed accumulate press coverage, filings and web presence; companies that fail often disappear. A backtest that retrieves today’s web therefore risks scoring the outcome rather than the application. Our retrieval is not restricted to the decision date, so this risk applies to our own experiments; we measure it rather than assume it away. Recent work in financial LLM evaluation identifies exactly this channel, together with parametric memory in model weights and survivorship in the evaluation universe, as the most common threats to validity ( Kong et al., 2026 ; Lopez-Lira et al., 2025 ; Glasserman and Lin, 2023 ; Sarkar and Vafa, 2024 ) . We structure our evaluation around those threats.
paragraphs.zh: 其中最重要的是前视偏差。 我们的主要防线是奖励那些能够被外部佐证的论断。 后来成功的公司会积累新闻报道、备案文件和网络足迹；而失败的公司往往消失无踪。 因此，检索当今网络数据的回测，有可能评分的是结果本身，而不是应用的表现。 我们的检索并不限于决策日期，因此这一风险同样适用于我们自己的实验；我们对它进行度量，而不是假设其不存在。 近期关于金融大语言模型评估的研究，恰好将这一渠道，连同模型权重中的参数记忆以及评估范围中的幸存者偏差，列为最常见的效度威胁（ Kong et al., 2026 ; Lopez-Lira et al., 2025 ; Glasserman and Lin, 2023 ; Sarkar and Vafa, 2024 ）。 我们围绕这些威胁构建评估。

paragraphs.en: A design pattern for evidence-gated scoring (§ 3 ): a division of labour in which the LLM reads and rates while code combines the ratings, a stage-aware corroboration ceiling, a second-pass sceptic whose adjustments can only lower scores, and a declared-dependency pre-fetch that assembles the evidence before generation and stores the source list for audit. We state the arithmetic consequences of the ceiling explicitly (Proposition 3.1 ).

paragraphs.en: A leakage audit on a recorded-outcome VC portfolio (§ 5 ): an explicit account of the leakage channels our retrieval does not control, corroboration rates by outcome class, a corroboration-only baseline that isolates how much of the score is explained by evidence availability alone, and a maturity restriction that reduces the influence of very recent investments, whose outcomes are still unresolved (§ 5.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对已录得结果的 VC 投资组合进行的泄漏审计（§ 5）：明确说明我们的检索未能控制的泄漏渠道、按结果类别统计的佐证率、仅基于佐证的基线（用以分离仅凭证据可得性就能解释的分数比例），以及成熟度限制（该限制降低了结果尚未明朗的近期投资的影响）（§ 5.1）。

paragraphs.en: Empirical results on 243 holdings, with 142 mature holdings as the primary set (§ 6 ): rank correlation and AUC with bootstrap intervals, comparison with structured-field and corroboration-only baselines, an ablation of each guardrail, and an analyst assessment of total analyst time and factual-support quality (§ 6.3 , § 6.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在243个持仓上的实证结果，其中142个成熟持仓作为主要数据集（§ 6）：秩相关与AUC及自助法置信区间、与结构化字段基线及仅交叉验证基线的比较、各项防护机制的消融实验，以及关于分析师总耗时与事实支撑质量的分析师评估（§ 6.3、§ 6.4）。

paragraphs.en: We claim that the pattern is implementable in a production setting; that its guardrails behave as designed (neither guardrail ever raised a score, and their effect on the composite is measured); and that on 142 mature investments the full pipeline’s score is rank-correlated with total-value multiples, with a modest but measurable margin over an unconstrained LLM. We do not claim that the pipeline would screen incoming deals better than analysts do, that the improvement survives without hindsight in the retrieved evidence, that the lower-only rule matters beyond what any second review would add, or that scores are stable across repeated runs. Section 7 sets out each of these limits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们声称该模式可在生产环境中实现；其防护栏按设计运行（两个防护栏均未抬升任何评分，且其对复合评分的影响已被测量）；并且在142个成熟投资案例上，完整流水线的评分与总价值倍数呈秩相关，相对无约束的大语言模型有适度但可测量的优势。 我们不声称该流水线筛选新交易的表现会优于分析师，不声称这种改进在没有后见之明的检索证据下仍然成立，不声称仅下调规则的作用超出任何二次评审所能带来的增益，也不声称评分在多次重复运行之间是稳定的。 第7节列出了上述每一项局限。

paragraphs.en: Prior work predicts startup success from tabular and relational data, typically using public databases such as Crunchbase ( Arroyo et al., 2019 ; Żbikowski and Antosiuk, 2021 ; Lyu et al., 2021 ; Cao et al., 2023 ) , and benchmarks algorithms against investor judgement ( Retterath, 2020 ) . Related work models business-angel decisions ( Katcharovski and Maxwell, 2025 ) and automates pitch-deck analysis ( Chauhan et al., 2024 ) . Survey evidence describes how VCs actually decide, with the founding team weighted most heavily ( Gompers et al., 2020 ) , which motivates the high founder weight in our rubric. Two limitations recur: public datasets rarely contain realised fund-level returns or write-offs, and screening is usually framed as single-pass classification rather than as a staged, human-supervised workflow. Our dataset addresses the first limitation for one fund; it does not remove the selection problem discussed in § 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究基于表格和关系型数据预测初创公司成败，通常使用 Crunchbase 等公开数据库（Arroyo et al., 2019；Żbikowski and Antosiuk, 2021；Lyu et al., 2021；Cao et al., 2023），并将算法与投资人判断进行基准比较（Retterath, 2020）。 相关工作对商业天使的投资决策进行建模（Katcharovski and Maxwell, 2025），并实现了路演文档分析的自动化（Chauhan et al., 2024）。 调查证据描述了风险投资人实际如何决策，其中创始团队的权重最高（Gompers et al., 2020），这为我们评分标准中较高的创始人权重提供了依据。 两个局限反复出现：公开数据集很少包含已实现的基金层面回报或核销，且筛选通常被构架为单轮分类，而非分阶段、有人工监督的工作流程。 我们的数据集针对单一基金解决了第一个局限；它并未消除第 7 节所讨论的选择偏差问题。

paragraphs.en: LLMs exhibit sycophancy, aligning outputs with the user’s or document’s stance ( Sharma et al., 2024 ; Perez et al., 2023 ; Ben Natan and Tsur, 2026 ) , and LLM judges show position and verbosity biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . In investment analysis specifically, LLMs show systematic preferences that can override the evidence presented ( Lee et al., 2025 ) . Hosted LLMs are not reproducible even at temperature zero ( Atıl et al., 2025 ) , partly because of batch-dependent numerics on shared inference servers ( He and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) . Chain-of-thought explanations can be unfaithful to the computation that produced an answer ( Turpin et al., 2023 ) . These findings motivate keeping the model out of the arithmetic and storing evidence rather than relying on regenerated explanations, in line with arguments for inherently interpretable models in high-stakes settings ( Rudin, 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型存在谄媚性，其输出会迎合用户或文档的立场（Sharma et al., 2024；Perez et al., 2023；Ben Natan and Tsur, 2026），且作为评判者的大型语言模型表现出位置偏差和冗长偏差（Zheng et al., 2023）。 具体到投资分析领域，大型语言模型表现出可能压倒所呈现证据的系统性偏好（Lee et al., 2025）。 托管式大型语言模型即使在温度为零时也不可复现（Atıl et al., 2025），部分原因是共享推理服务器上依赖于批处理的数值计算（He and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025）。 思维链解释可能无法忠实反映产生答案的实际计算过程（Turpin et al., 2023）。 这些发现促使我们将模型排除在算术计算之外，并存储证据而非依赖重新生成的解释，这与在高风险场景下使用内在可解释模型的主张相一致（Rudin, 2019）。

paragraphs.en: The FCA describes itself as a technology-agnostic, principles-based and outcomes-focused regulator and does not impose AI-specific rules; it points instead to existing frameworks including the Principles for Businesses, the Senior Managers and Certification Regime (SM&CR), the Senior Management Arrangements, Systems and Controls sourcebook (SYSC) and, where relevant, the Consumer Duty ( Financial Conduct Authority, 2024 ) . paragraphs.en: An analyst uploads up to 10 PDF decks per batch. A worker extracts text (pypdf) and runs one LLM pass that produces a structured profile (company name, sector, stage, capital ask, revenue band, geography, founders and their roles). The harness then gathers external evidence: a Companies House profile snapshot (status, incorporation date, charges) and active-officer list ( Companies House, 2026 ) , and a templated set of at most 10 web queries. There is one query per founder (up to three), plus a second where a role is stated; three company queries (news and funding, competitors, customers and traction); and one market-size query when a sector was extracted. Queries go through a metasearch library ( ddgs ) that rotates between several search backends, returning five results per query; the top two pages per query are crawled and truncated to 4,000 characters. Every retrieved page is assigned a numbered source index.

paragraphs.en: This does not make the LLM deterministic. All calls use temperature 0.1 with no fixed seed, and server-side numerics vary even at temperature zero ( Atıl et al., 2025 ; He and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) . What it does guarantee is narrower and, for audit purposes, more useful: (a) the queries are fixed by template rather than chosen by the model, and the evidence is assembled before generation, so the model cannot change what it retrieves while answering; and (b) because the source list, the category scores before and after each guardrail and the model identifier are stored, the decision record can be inspected later without regenerating anything. Triage does not store full page text or the full prompt, so a triage screen can be audited at the level of sources, not passages; stage evaluations additionally store the full prompt, the response and a prompt hash. Pre-fetch does not make the evidence identical across screens of the same deck: search backends rotate, pages change, and search results are cached for only 24 hours. We did not measure run-to-run variance (§ 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这并不会使该大语言模型（LLM）具有确定性。 所有调用均使用 temperature 0.1 且不固定随机种子，即使在 temperature 为零时，服务器端的数值计算也会存在差异（Atıl et al., 2025；He and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025）。 它所保证的范围更窄，但从审计角度来看更有用：(a) 查询由模板固定而非由模型自行选择，且证据在生成之前就已汇集，因此模型无法在回答过程中改变其检索的内容；(b) 由于来源列表、每道护栏前后的类别得分以及模型标识符都会被存储，决策记录可以在事后被查验，而无需重新生成任何内容。 分诊（triage）不会存储完整的页面文本或完整提示词，因此分诊筛选可以在来源层面（而非段落层面）进行审计；各阶段评估则额外存储完整提示词、响应以及提示词哈希值。 预取并不能使同一演示文稿（deck）中不同页面的证据完全一致：搜索后端会发生轮换，页面内容会变化，且搜索结果仅缓存 24 小时。 我们并未测量各次运行之间的差异（§ 7）。

sents.en: Pre-fetch does not make the evidence identical across screens of the same deck: search backends rotate, pages change, and search results are cached for only 24 hours.

paragraphs.en: The dataset is a portfolio record provided by Sapphire Capital Partners, a UK early-stage fund manager: 245 company records exported from the manager’s portfolio-administration system on 8 July 2026, which we use as the valuation date. Two records have no recorded investment amount (one with zero value, one with a residual value of £382) and are excluded as data-entry artefacts, leaving N = 243 N=243 SEIS/EIS investments made between September 2015 and April 2026; none is a VCT holding. These represent £272.50m invested and £417.22m of total value (realised proceeds of £46.4m plus £370.8m of unrealised value at the latest marks), an aggregate multiple of 1.53 × \times . Stages at entry are seed (168), pre-seed (73) and Series A (2).

paragraphs.en: Outcome labels depend on how long a company has had to succeed or fail. Table 3 shows that none of the 73 investments made within two years of the valuation date has been written off, and 81% of them are still held at cost, typically because they have not yet been revalued. A score that merely tracks company age would therefore appear to identify write-offs: a logistic regression on entry year alone reaches AUC 0 = 0.72 {}_{0}=0.72 [0.65, 0.78] on all 243 deals. We use the 142 investments made at least three years before the valuation date (43 write-offs, 22 above 2 × 2\times ) as the primary evaluation set. paragraphs.en: Every deal in the dataset was approved by the fund’s analysts and committee. The evaluation therefore measures whether DealsFlow ranks funded deals by eventual outcome , a harder, conditional task than separating good from bad applications in raw deal flow. It cannot measure false negatives (good companies the system would have rejected), because rejected applications have no observed outcome. We return to this in § 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 数据集中的每一笔交易都经过了该基金的分析师和委员会的批准。 因此，该评估衡量的是 DealsFlow 是否能按最终结果对已获融资的交易进行排序，这比在原始交易流中区分好坏申请是一项更难的、有条件的任务。 它无法衡量假阴性（即系统本来会拒绝的优秀公司），因为被拒绝的申请没有可观察到的结果。 我们将在 § 7 中回到这一点。

paragraphs.en: Our primary metric is Spearman’s ρ \rho between composite score and total-value multiple, that is, realised proceeds plus current marks over capital invested; many marks on active holdings are the manager’s valuations rather than realised returns. Secondary metrics are two AUCs and per-class means with standard deviations. AUC 0 is the probability that a randomly chosen deal that was not written off scores higher than a randomly chosen write-off; AUC 2 is the probability that a randomly chosen deal with multiple > 2 × >2\times scores higher than a randomly chosen other deal. Intervals are 95% percentile bootstrap intervals over deals with 10,000 resamples ( Efron and Tibshirani, 1994 ) ; differences between configurations are tested with a paired bootstrap on the same deals. All investment-outcome results use the 142 mature deals; the analyst measures use the samples described in § 5.6 . With 142 deals and 43 write-offs, the half-width of a 95% interval on AUC 0 is roughly ± 0.10 \pm 0.10 (Hanley–McNeil approximation at AUC ≈ 0.65 \approx 0.65 ), so differences smaller than that are inconclusive; paired comparisons on the same deals are more sensitive.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要指标是综合得分与总价值倍数（即已实现回报加上当前估值再除以投入资本）之间的 Spearman ρ \rho；许多活跃持仓的估值是管理人给出的估值，而非已实现的回报。 次要指标是两个 AUC 以及带标准差的各类别均值。 AUC 0 是随机选取的一笔未被核销的交易得分高于随机选取的一笔被核销交易的概率；AUC 2 是随机选取的一笔倍数 > 2 × >2\times 的交易得分高于随机选取的另一笔交易的概率。 区间为针对交易在 10,000 次重抽样下的 95% 百分位自助区间（ Efron and Tibshirani, 1994 ）；不同配置之间的差异通过在同一批交易上进行的配对自助检验来检验。 所有投资结果均使用这 142 笔成熟交易；分析师测量则使用 § 5.6 中描述的样本。 在 142 笔交易和 43 笔核销的情况下，AUC 0 的 95% 区间的半宽约为 ± 0.10 \pm 0.10（AUC ≈ 0.65 \approx 0.65 时的 Hanley–McNeil 近似），因此小于该值的差异不具有结论性；在同一批交易上的配对比较更为灵敏。

sents.en: Our primary metric is Spearman’s ρ \rho between composite score and total-value multiple, that is, realised proceeds plus current marks over capital invested; many marks on active holdings are the manager’s valuations rather than realised returns.
sents.zh: 我们的主要指标是综合得分与总价值倍数（即已实现回报加上当前估值再除以投入资本）之间的 Spearman ρ \rho；许多活跃持仓的估值是管理人给出的估值，而非已实现的回报。

sents.en: Secondary metrics are two AUCs and per-class means with standard deviations.
sents.zh: 次要指标是两个 AUC 以及带标准差的各类别均值。

sents.en: AUC 0 is the probability that a randomly chosen deal that was not written off scores higher than a randomly chosen write-off; AUC 2 is the probability that a randomly chosen deal with multiple > 2 × >2\times scores higher than a randomly chosen other deal.
sents.zh: AUC 0 是随机选取的一笔未被核销的交易得分高于随机选取的一笔被核销交易的概率；AUC 2 是随机选取的一笔倍数 > 2 × >2\times 的交易得分高于随机选取的另一笔交易的概率。

sents.en: Intervals are 95% percentile bootstrap intervals over deals with 10,000 resamples ( Efron and Tibshirani, 1994 ) ; differences between configurations are tested with a paired bootstrap on the same deals.
sents.zh: 区间为针对交易在 10,000 次重抽样下的 95% 百分位自助区间（ Efron and Tibshirani, 1994 ）；不同配置之间的差异通过在同一批交易上进行的配对自助检验来检验。

sents.en: With 142 deals and 43 write-offs, the half-width of a 95% interval on AUC 0 is roughly ± 0.10 \pm 0.10 (Hanley–McNeil approximation at AUC ≈ 0.65 \approx 0.65 ), so differences smaller than that are inconclusive; paired comparisons on the same deals are more sensitive.

paragraphs.en: Investment outcomes cannot show whether the harness helps an analyst, so we add two measures. Both use 20 inbound applications that are separate from the historical portfolio and have no known outcomes. Two analysts took part. Each application was triaged once manually and once with DealsFlow, and for each application one analyst performed the manual triage while the other used DealsFlow, so neither analyst processed the same application twice. Assignments were counterbalanced across the 20 applications, with each analyst doing 10 applications in each workflow.

paragraphs.en: We measure the time from opening a generated report to a completed final assessment. This includes reading the report, verifying its sources, correcting errors and completing the assessment, not only the machine processing time. The comparison is with manual triage of the same application, timed from opening the deck to a completed summary. Machine time, which runs without an analyst, is recorded separately. The four assisted components (reading the report, verifying sources, correcting errors and completing the final assessment) were logged separately.

paragraphs.en: Two reviewers independently rated every distinct claim that cites a numbered source in each of the 20 generated reports: 240 claims, so 480 rating decisions before reconciliation. For each claim the reviewer opens the source and records whether it supports the claim: supported, partly supported, not supported, or source not accessible. For the four ceiling-eligible categories of each report (80 labels), reviewers also record whether an external or registry label is confirmed by a cited source, and whether a category labelled deck_only or none could have been corroborated by a source the harness missed. They list material issues the report does not mention, such as contradictions with filings, and count the corrections made before the assessment was completed. The two reviewers are the two analysts who took part in the timing. They rated every claim independently before any discussion, then discussed disagreements against the cited sources, and a third reviewer adjudicated unresolved cases. The third reviewer is one of the authors, who manages the partnership between the university and the fund manager. We report agreement between the two reviewers on their initial ratings, calculated before reconciliation, as the share of claims rated alike and as Cohen’s κ \kappa ; the support counts we report are after reconciliation.
paragraphs.zh: 两名评审员独立地对 20 份生成报告中每一条引用了编号来源的不同论断进行评分：共 240 条论断，因此在协商前共有 480 次评分决定。 对于每条论断，评审员会打开来源并记录其是否支持该论断：支持、部分支持、不支持，或来源无法访问。 对于每份报告的四个可评估上限的类别（共 80 个标签），评审员还会记录外部或登记库标签是否得到所引用来源的证实，以及被标记为 deck_only 或 none 的类别是否本可以通过评测框架遗漏的来源得到佐证。 他们会列出报告中未提及的重大问题，例如与申报文件相矛盾之处，并统计在评估完成之前所做的更正数量。 两名评审员正是参与计时环节的两名分析人员。 他们先在任何讨论之前独立对每条论断评分，然后对照所引用的来源讨论分歧之处，未解决的案例由第三名评审员裁决。 第三名评审员是本文作者之一，负责管理大学与基金管理人之间的合作关系。 我们报告两名评审员初始评分之间的一致性，该一致性在协商前计算，以评分相同的论断占比以及 Cohen 的 κ \kappa 表示；我们所报告的支持计数是协商之后的数值。

paragraphs.en: Corroboration availability differs by outcome (Kruskal–Wallis p = 0.031 p=0.031 ). Investments that went on to exceed 2 × 2\times had 63.6% of their factual categories corroborated, against 37.8% for write-offs; the three middle classes lie between, at 43–46%. This is the pattern a hindsight-contaminated retrieval would produce, and it is also the pattern that genuine early traction would produce. With undated search we cannot tell which, and we do not claim to.

paragraphs.en: Two results limit how much corroboration alone can explain. First, a baseline that scores each deal only by its fraction of corroborated categories reaches ρ = 0.22 \rho=0.22 [0.05, 0.37] and AUC 0 = 0.61 {}_{0}=0.61 [0.50, 0.70] (Table 5 ), well below the full pipeline; the paired difference in ρ \rho is + 0.235 +0.235 [0.037, 0.429] (Table 6 ). Second, the stage-aware ceiling, the mechanism that depends on the corroboration labels, is weak: it changes the composite of 48.6% of deals, by 1.23 points on average (Table 8 ), and the ceiling-only configuration is almost identical to the unconstrained LLM ( ρ = 0.384 \rho=0.384 against 0.381 0.381 ). The ceiling therefore accounts for little of the overall discrimination, which comes mostly from the model’s category scores. But those scores are produced from the same undated evidence, so the corroboration gap remains a plausible route for hindsight, and the results below should be read with that caveat.
paragraphs.zh: 两项结果限定了仅靠佐证所能解释的程度。 首先，一个仅按每笔交易获佐证类别比例打分的基线达到 ρ = 0.22 \rho=0.22 [0.05, 0.37] 与 AUC 0 = 0.61 {}_{0}=0.61 [0.50, 0.70]（表 5），远低于完整流水线；两者在 ρ \rho 上的成对差值为 + 0.235 +0.235 [0.037, 0.429]（表 6）。 其次，阶段感知上限这一依赖佐证标签的机制作用很弱：它改变了 48.6% 交易的复合得分，平均变动 1.23 分（表 8），且仅设上限的配置与无约束的大语言模型几乎相同（ ρ = 0.384 \rho=0.384 对 0.381 0.381 ）。 因此，上限对整体区分能力的贡献很小，区分能力主要来自模型的类别得分。 但这些得分产生自同一批缺乏日期的证据，因此佐证差距仍是事后诸葛亮效应的一条可能途径，下文的结果应带着这一保留意见来解读。

The fund’s cheque size, a proxy for its conviction at the time, showed no clear separation of write-offs (AUC 0 = 0.51 {}_{0}=0.51 ).

paragraphs.en: On 142 mature investments the full pipeline’s score is positively rank-correlated with the total-value multiple ( ρ = 0.45 \rho=0.45 ) and identifies write-offs better than chance (AUC 0 = 0.71 {}_{0}=0.71 ), and the guardrails improve on an unconstrained LLM by a small but consistent margin (RQ2, RQ3). The improvement comes mostly from the sceptic pass; the corroboration ceiling adds little by itself. We did not isolate why: the lower-only rule, an extra review, or less sampling noise from combining two calls would each produce this pattern. The results do not establish screening skill (RQ1). Later successes were corroborated more often than write-offs, retrieval was not date-restricted, and the model’s knowledge cutoff postdates most outcomes, so hindsight cannot be excluded as an explanation for part or all of the correlation. Discrimination is concentrated between the best outcomes and the rest; the middle groups overlap heavily. In a separate study of 20 inbound applications, total analyst time fell from 44.7 to 18.9 minutes per application (a 57.8% reduction) even after verification and correction, and 84.2% of 240 cited claims were fully supported by their sources (RQ4, RQ5). But 70% of reports needed at least one correction, so the reports were not used without analyst verification. Neither result says anything about whether the system improves investment decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 在142笔成熟投资上，完整流程的评分与总价值倍数呈正相关秩相关（ρ = 0.45 \rho=0.45），并且识别核销项目的能力优于随机水平（AUC 0 = 0.71 {}_{0}=0.71），而且防护机制相较无约束的大语言模型带来了小幅但持续的改进（RQ2, RQ3）。 改进主要来自怀疑者环节；证伪上限本身几乎没有额外贡献。 我们没有分离出原因：仅下调的规则、额外的一次审查，或将两次调用相结合带来的更低采样噪声，其中任何一项都可能产生这种模式。 这些结果并不能证明具备筛选能力（RQ1）。 后期成功案例被证实的频率高于核销案例，检索没有日期限制，且模型的知识截止日期晚于大多数结果，因此后见之明无法被排除为部分或全部相关性的解释。 区分能力集中在最好的结果与其余结果之间；中间各组高度重叠。 在另一项针对20份主动提交申请的研究中，即使经过验证与修正，分析师每份申请的总时间仍从44.7分钟降至18.9分钟（减少57.8%），且240条被引用的声明中有84.2%完全得到了其来源的支持（RQ4, RQ5）。 但70%的报告至少需要一处修正，因此这些报告未经分析师验证不会投入使用。 这两项结果都没有说明该系统是否改善了投资决策。

paragraphs.en: The analyst measures rest on 20 applications and two reviewers who work with the fund manager and are not independent of the system’s developers. Every application was triaged by both workflows but by different analysts, so the paired comparison confounds workflow with analyst; counterbalancing balances this across the two analysts but cannot remove it, and with two analysts we cannot estimate variation between analysts. The measures show whether the reports are usable and accurate, not whether the system improves investment decisions. The third reviewer, who adjudicated unresolved ratings, is an author and manages the partnership, so the adjudication was not independent either.

paragraphs.zh: 对实时交易流进行前瞻性评估，这从构造上消除了前视问题；针对留出的结果测试匹配与调整组件；对注入防御开展红队研究；在调用预算匹配的条件下，将仅下调的怀疑者与可以双向修改评分的审阅者进行比较；以及对存储的证据进行重复运行以测量稳定性。

paragraphs.en: DealsFlow keeps the LLM away from the composite score: the LLM reads the deck, cites evidence and rates each category, while code combines the ratings, caps them and only ever lowers them, and the sources and the scores before and after each guardrail are recorded for audit. Evaluating such a system on historical deals is easy to get wrong, because the main guardrail rewards exactly the kind of evidence that hindsight inflates. On the 142 mature investments in our 243-deal SEIS/EIS portfolio, the full pipeline’s score correlates with total-value multiples ( ρ = 0.45 \rho=0.45 , 95% CI [0.32, 0.57]) and improves modestly on an unconstrained LLM, mostly through the sceptic pass. But write-offs were corroborated less often than later successes and retrieval was not date-restricted, so the results may overstate screening skill. In a separate study of 20 inbound applications, analyst time fell by 58% even after verification and correction, and 84% of cited claims were fully supported, but 70% of reports still needed a correction. We hope the leakage diagnostics, more than the system itself, are useful to others evaluating LLM screening tools on historical financial data.
paragraphs.zh: DealsFlow 让 LLM 远离综合评分：LLM 负责阅读路演材料、引用证据并为每个类别打分，而代码负责合并这些评分、对其进行封顶并且只会下调分数，同时每个防护栏前后的来源和分数都会被记录以供审计。 在历史交易上评估这样的系统很容易出错，因为主要的防护栏恰恰奖励后见之明会夸大的那类证据。 在我们 243 笔交易的 SEIS/EIS 投资组合中的 142 笔成熟投资上，完整流程的评分与总价值倍数相关（ ρ = 0.45 \rho=0.45 ，95% 置信区间 [0.32, 0.57]），并且相比不受约束的 LLM 有适度提升，这主要归功于怀疑者环节。 但核销案例得到印证的频率低于后来的成功案例，且检索未按日期限制，因此结果可能高估了筛选能力。 在另一项针对 20 份入站申请的研究中，即使经过核验与修正，分析师时间仍减少了 58%，84% 的引用论断得到完全支持，但仍有 70% 的报告需要修正。 我们希望这些泄漏诊断方法，而非系统本身，能对其他在历史金融数据上评估 LLM 筛选工具的人有所帮助。

sents.en: DealsFlow keeps the LLM away from the composite score: the LLM reads the deck, cites evidence and rates each category, while code combines the ratings, caps them and only ever lowers them, and the sources and the scores before and after each guardrail are recorded for audit.
sents.zh: DealsFlow 让 LLM 远离综合评分：LLM 负责阅读路演材料、引用证据并为每个类别打分，而代码负责合并这些评分、对其进行封顶并且只会下调分数，同时每个防护栏前后的来源和分数都会被记录以供审计。

sents.en: Evaluating such a system on historical deals is easy to get wrong, because the main guardrail rewards exactly the kind of evidence that hindsight inflates.
sents.zh: 在历史交易上评估这样的系统很容易出错，因为主要的防护栏恰恰奖励后见之明会夸大的那类证据。

sents.en: On the 142 mature investments in our 243-deal SEIS/EIS portfolio, the full pipeline’s score correlates with total-value multiples ( ρ = 0.45 \rho=0.45 , 95% CI [0.32, 0.57]) and improves modestly on an unconstrained LLM, mostly through the sceptic pass.
sents.zh: 在我们 243 笔交易的 SEIS/EIS 投资组合中的 142 笔成熟投资上，完整流程的评分与总价值倍数相关（ ρ = 0.45 \rho=0.45 ，95% 置信区间 [0.32, 0.57]），并且相比不受约束的 LLM 有适度提升，这主要归功于怀疑者环节。

sents.en: But write-offs were corroborated less often than later successes and retrieval was not date-restricted, so the results may overstate screening skill.
sents.zh: 但核销案例得到印证的频率低于后来的成功案例，且检索未按日期限制，因此结果可能高估了筛选能力。

sents.en: In a separate study of 20 inbound applications, analyst time fell by 58% even after verification and correction, and 84% of cited claims were fully supported, but 70% of reports still needed a correction.
sents.zh: 在另一项针对 20 份入站申请的研究中，即使经过核验与修正，分析师时间仍减少了 58%，84% 的引用论断得到完全支持，但仍有 70% 的报告需要修正。

sents.en: We hope the leakage diagnostics, more than the system itself, are useful to others evaluating LLM screening tools on historical financial data.
sents.zh: 我们希望这些泄漏诊断方法，而非系统本身，能对其他在历史金融数据上评估 LLM 筛选工具的人有所帮助。

All figures in this paper are aggregated; no company, founder or investor is identifiable, and investor-level records were not used. paragraphs.en: A screening tool that rewards public evidence can disadvantage founders with a small public footprint, which may correlate with geography, background or access to networks. The stage-aware ceiling softens this for early-stage companies but does not remove it, and we did not test for disparate impact across founder groups. Because the system can reject automatically below a threshold, such founders could be excluded without a human reading their deck; we recommend that deployments sample and review automated rejections. Our results show only a modest correlation with outcomes that may be inflated by leakage, so scores should not be read as predictions or used without human judgement. Finally, founder decks are confidential, and sending them to a hosted model carries a confidentiality risk, which we reduce by using an EU-region deployment under Azure’s data terms.
paragraphs.zh: 一种奖励公开证据的筛选工具可能会让公开影响力较小的创始人处于劣势，而这种影响力可能与地域、背景或人脉资源相关。 分阶段的评分上限在一定程度上缓解了早期公司的这一问题，但并未彻底消除，且我们并未检验不同创始人群体之间是否存在差别性影响。 由于系统在阈值以下可以自动拒绝，这类创始人可能在没有人工阅读其商业计划书的情况下就被排除；我们建议部署方对自动拒绝的案例进行抽样审查。 我们的结果仅显示出与结果之间适度的相关性，且该相关性可能因数据泄漏而偏高，因此评分不应被解读为预测结果，也不应在缺乏人工判断的情况下使用。 最后，创始人的商业计划书属于机密文件，将其发送给托管模型存在保密风险；我们通过使用符合 Azure 数据条款的欧盟区域部署来降低这一风险。
